· RSI trajectory (42.3→34.8) + Entered oversold territory, downward momentum persists
· MACD histogram trajectory (87.7348→-536.7635) + Worsening, strengthening bearish trend
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 176,105 KRW) + Bandwidth at 30.72%, suggesting potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (179,200 KRW) + Based on 5-day low, key defense line on decline
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW) + First resistance zone for short-term bounces
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low 181,400 KRW, 20-day low 179,200 KRW, confirming continued downtrend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.16x) + Increased volume on recent decline, confirming selling pressure
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend) + Maintain wait-and-see until 179,200 KRW support is confirmed
